source_policy: Spotrac-first cap tracker v1: active roster, cap holds, and visible money cells come from Spotrac multi-year team pages. Databallr is QA-only and does not override displayed rows.
notes: Season years use NBA season end year: 2027 is 2026-27, 2028 is 2027-28, and so on.
The Spotrac-powered tracker starts at 2026-27 and intentionally drops the prior 2025-26 tracker season.
Guarantee percentages are hover-only on Spotrac and are not captured at scale in v1.
Manual guarantee, pick, and exception override CSVs remain available for targeted additions.

seasons.source: Spotrac 2026-27 projection; apron estimated from current cap/apron ratio

contracts.contract_notes: Spotrac sections: Active Roster, Cap Hold
Spotrac sections: Active Roster, Cap Hold

warnings: 2026-27 system levels include projected cap/tax/apron inputs from Spotrac 2026-27 projection; apron estimated from current cap/apron ratio.
2027-28 system levels include projected cap/tax/apron inputs from https://www.spotrac.com/nba/cap/_/year/2027/sort/cap_maximum_space.
2028-29 system levels include projected cap/tax/apron inputs from Spotrac projection, 5% cap growth assumption.
2029-30 system levels include projected cap/tax/apron inputs from https://www.spotrac.com/nba/cap/_/year/2029.
2030-31 system levels include projected cap/tax/apron inputs from Spotrac projection, 5% cap growth assumption.
Guarantee percentages are not scraped from Spotrac hover-only tooltips; normal active salary cells are treated as fully on-book salary unless ref/cap_tracker_guarantees.csv overrides them.
Spotrac option/non-guaranteed color classes are not yet available in the persisted scrape, so v1 maps only text-visible option/non-guarantee labels.
